title: Privacy policy
content:
Privacy policy for Larkspur Supply Co.. Last updated 1 September 2026.

Table of contents linking to each section below.

Sections:
1. What we collect: your name, email, and address when you join; what you buy, so we can calculate your dividend; and rental records.
2. How we use it: to run your membership, process orders and rentals, and send the newsletter if you ask for it.
3. Who we share it with: our payment processor and our shipping carrier, only as needed. We never sell personal data.
4. How long we keep it: purchase records for seven years, as tax law requires; everything else until you ask us to delete it.
5. Your rights: you can ask for a copy of your data, a correction, or deletion. Email privacy@larkspur.coop.
6. Cookies: we use one cookie to keep you signed in, and no tracking cookies.
